items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: as early as Abe Lyman, Weary Weasel. ... And we liked them.

ctx.x: You were trying for more elaborate arrangements. And then we found out who were you imitating or trying to come up to.

Well, even I remember something, was it a long time ago with Blackish Simmons, as early as Abe Lyman, Weary Weasel. Do you remember that? And that sort of thing. And the old Castle Lomas used to have kind of swing records for Brunswick a long time ago. And we liked them. This was society bands. Well I know, but they had all kinds of sometimes swing records that came out. Yes. Before this. This is before the word swing now.
